method.benign_gate: independent full-prefix context-aware Mistral judge validates safe Qwen trajectory
method.malicious_gate: validated Qwen rollout AND reproducible fresh paired evidence baseline remains unsafe
method.pivot_policy: only counterfactually supported evidence turns populate pivot_turn_id
method.primary_pair_policy: retain complete validated malicious/benign twins only
method.span_policy: only counterfactually supported spans receive positive attribution supervision
method.standalone_hard_benign_policy: validated standalones are evaluation-only stress records

pair_retention.policy: both malicious and benign twins must pass; no orphan twin enters primary corpus
